in_sanskrit.name: Mintu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intelligent, Delightful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mintu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Manditu', meaning 'gratifying' or 'delightful'. In Hindu mythology, Mintu is a name associated with the god Ganesha, who is known for his intelligence and wisdom. This name signifies a strong-willed, intelligent, and delightful individual.
